_comment: English body for wps-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by WPS AI’s generative capabilities; the model and available features vary by membership tier, edition and region.
axes.runtime: Runs in WPS cloud and client, covering Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation and PDF; some capabilities are triggered locally in the client.
axes.local_files: Can process local WPS documents and uploaded files; cloud features require sign-in and sync, and offline capability is limited.
axes.background: Writing, spreadsheet, presentation and PDF tasks are triggered inside the document; there is no general agent that survives shutdown.
axes.tools: Integrated with WPS Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation, PDF, cloud documents and templates; supports Chinese office formats.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current document, template and cloud documents on the account; cross-team knowledge-base capability is limited. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Commercial use and data terms follow the WPS membership agreement; confirm sensitive information before uploading local documents to the cloud.
axes.fit: Fits: Chinese Office documents, spreadsheet formulas, first-draft presentations and PDF summaries. Does not fit: fully offline work or deep cross-platform integration.
